scope: Causal descriptive market regime and non-executable range-reversion setup only. No new DecisionProvider, Action, quantity, deployed policy or order.

definitions.boundaryZones: bottom/top quarter of prior OHLC span; signal excluded
definitions.entryConfirmation: signal wick below old support, close back above support inside lower quarter, bullish body and close above preceding close; two-sided sweep veto
definitions.stop: max(2%,2*prior ATR14/fee-inclusive basis, distance to one prior ATR below old support); reject above selected limit, never clip
definitions.target: prior resistance converted to fill-based target; reject outside 3%..40%
definitions.noClaims: No stationarity, probability, edge, risk budget, depth or fill permission inferred.

audit: Existing frozen dataset and original Safe replay clocks/quotes, cash-only observer. Both original fee scenarios. Classifications/counts only, no strategy fills or return comparison. Uncertainty and same-universe dependence retained.
